text:
Hannah Lee: Auditor asked for a compact "evidence capsule" for 2025-04-15 (24h) covering RBAC modifications, KMS usage, and vuln crosswalk. They want chained mapping (change -> PR -> approver) plus 3 decrypt traces. No customer PII.
Marcus Irwin: We'll pull k8s audit + Okta SCIM deltas and CloudTrail KMS events. Keep emails replaced with user_sha256:<hex>. Include PR refs in mapping.
Zoe Patel: For KMS include Decrypt and GenerateDataKey events, key Describe snapshots, and GetKeyRotationStatus output. Never include plaintext or key material.
Victor Nguyen: Packaging plan: zip bundle named redwood_evidence_2025-04-15.zip, files: rbac_changes.csv, kms_events.ndjson, key_metadata.json, change_map.csv, vuln_map.csv, MANIFEST.txt, README.md. MANIFEST signed with GPG key sec-audit@redwood.
AuditorBot: Provide 3 end-to-end traces that link PR -> rolebinding change -> service account -> KMS requestId. Hashed principals acceptable.
Marcus Irwin: We'll canonicalize timestamps to ISO8601 UTC and include requestIds unchanged. Redaction rules recorded in README.
Zoe Patel: I'll select 3 safe traces and anonymize fields. Marcus, can you run Splunk query and drop raw exports into secure bucket?
Marcus Irwin: Yes. Splunk query (quick): index=audit OR index=cloudtrail ("RoleBinding" OR "Decrypt" OR "GenerateDataKey" OR "SCIM") | where _time>="2025-04-15T00:00:00Z" AND _time<"2025-04-16T00:00:00Z" | table _time,eventName,principal,resource,requestId,requestParameters,responseElements
Hannah Lee: Timeline: auditor wants by EOD Thursday. Can we sign and deliver by then? Marcus/Zoe/Victor?
Zoe Patel: I can process and package by Wednesday night.
Victor Nguyen: I'll sign the MANIFEST after QA; fingerprint: ABCD1234EFGH5678 (full fingerprint in README).
Marcus Irwin: I'll schedule a 20m walkthrough Thursday 10:00-10:20am PT and attach manifest sha256 in invite once signed.
Hannah Lee: Great. Post presigned S3 link + manifest hash in this thread when ready. Reminder: any request for unredacted samples requires LOA.
AuditorBot: Confirmed. Please ensure manifest lists sha256 for each file and includes signer identity.
Hannah Lee: Thanks team — update here when uploads live. :thumbsup:
